entries.title: Release asset upload lacks contents write permission
entries.root_cause: The workflow token has contents read permission, so GitHub rejects release asset uploads. Grant contents write to the publishing job.

entries.title: Release asset upload lacks contents write permission
entries.root_cause: The workflow token has contents read permission, so GitHub rejects release asset uploads. Grant contents write to the publishing job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later tag uploads a different archive from another runner; the same token permission prevents the upload.

entries.title: Release asset upload blocked by immutable release
entries.root_cause: The target release is immutable and cannot accept additional assets. Attach the asset before publishing or create a new release.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The token has contents write access, but this published release is immutable; granting token permission does not permit adding an asset.

entries.title: Manifest signing configuration missing
entries.root_cause: The manifest creation step requires CORDAGE_MANIFEST_PROFILE, but the job does not supply it. Configure that variable for the job.
